```yaml
name: Sync Wiki and Manage Releases

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'current/docs/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'current/docs/**'

jobs:
  sync-wiki:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'main')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Git User
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

      - name: Create Wiki Pages
        run: |
          # Create Home.md if it doesn't exist
          if [ ! -f "current/docs/Home.md" ]; then
            echo "# Welcome to the Task Orchestrator Wiki" > "current/docs/Home.md"
            echo "" >> "current/docs/Home.md"
            echo "This is the official documentation for the Task Orchestrator project." >> "current/docs/Home.md"
          fi
          
          # Create _Sidebar.md if it doesn't exist
          if [ ! -f "current/docs/_Sidebar.md" ]; then
            echo "* [Home](Home)" > "current/docs/_Sidebar.md"
            echo "* [Quick Start](Quick-Start)" >> "current/docs/_Sidebar.md"
            echo "* [Workflow Guide](Workflow-Guide)" >> "current/docs/_Sidebar.md"
            echo "* [API Reference](API-Reference)" >> "current/docs/_Sidebar.md"
          fi

      - name: Sync to Wiki
        run: |
          # Clone wiki repository
          git clone https://${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.wiki.git wiki
          
          # Copy docs to wiki
          cp -r current/docs/* wiki/
          
          # Commit and push changes
          cd wiki
          git add .
          git commit -m "Sync docs to wiki" || true
          git push origin main

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK 23
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '23'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3

      - name: Make gradlew executable
        run: chmod +x gradlew

      - name: Run tests
        run: ./gradlew :current:test --no-daemon

      - name: Publish Test Report
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          report_paths: '**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml'
          check_name: 'Test Results'

  build-and-publish:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK 23
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '23'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3

      - name: Make gradlew executable
        run: chmod +x gradlew

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=sha

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

      - name: Create Release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.sha }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.sha }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          body: "Automated release from GitHub Actions"
```
